nodes.name: 📥 Read Next Batch
nodes.notes:
Reads up to 300 users starting at checkpoint+2 (row 1 is header, checkpoint counts data rows processed).
If this returns 0 rows the workflow stops — Discord and Checkpoint nodes never run.

nodes.name: 🎭 Add Discord Role
nodes.notes:
Processes all items in the batch sequentially. continueOnFail means individual Discord errors
(user not in server, permission issues) do not crash the batch — those users are skipped and
the checkpoint still advances past them.

nodes.name: 🔢 Compute New Checkpoint
nodes.notes:
Collapses all N batch items into a single item with the new checkpoint value.
This ensures Advance Checkpoint writes exactly ONE row to Sheets per batch — no quota issues.

nodes.name: ✅ Advance Checkpoint
nodes.notes:
ONE Sheets write per batch of 300 users — far under any quota limit.
Matches the Config row by guild_id and updates only the checkpoint column.

parameters.content:
## Discord Mass Role Assignment

### Flow
```
[Trigger]
  → Read Config         (guild_id, role_id, checkpoint)
  → Read Next Batch     (300 users from checkpoint)
  → Add Discord Role    (all items, continueOnFail)
  → Compute Checkpoint  (collapse to 1 item)
  → Advance Checkpoint  (1 Sheets write per batch)
```

**Resume logic:**
The `checkpoint` column in Config stores how many users
have been processed. Each run reads the next 300 rows
from that offset. If the batch is empty (all done), the
workflow stops naturally — Discord and Checkpoint nodes
never execute.

**Google Sheets writes:** 1 per batch of 300 users.
No quota issues. No delay nodes needed.

**Discord rate limiting:** The Discord node handles
429s automatically using retry-after. A batch of 300
typically takes 1–3 min. The 5-min schedule gives a
safe buffer. Set Max Concurrent Executions = 1 in
Workflow Settings to prevent overlapping runs.

---

### Google Sheets layout

**Config tab — one data row:**
| guild_id | role_id | checkpoint |
|----------|---------|------------|
| 123...   | 987...  | 0          |

- checkpoint = 0 means start from row 2 (first user)
- After each batch it increments by the batch count
- To resume from user N, set checkpoint = N
- Column names must be exactly as shown

**Users tab — one column only:**
| user_id |
|---------|
| 111...  |
| 222...  |

Row 1 = header. Data starts at row 2.
No status column — checkpoint tracks position.

---

### Setup checklist
- [ ] Replace YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID on Read Config,
      Read Next Batch, and Advance Checkpoint
- [ ] Set Google Sheets credential on those 3 nodes
- [ ] Set Discord Bot credential on Add Discord Role
- [ ] Bot has MANAGE_ROLES, sits above target role
- [ ] Config checkpoint starts at 0
- [ ] Workflow Settings → Max concurrent executions = 1

---

### Throughput
300 users/batch · Discord ~5/sec · ~1 min to run
Schedule every 5 min = 18,000 users/hr
10k ≈ 35 min  ·  600k ≈ 33 hrs background

To go faster: change 301 → 501 in Read Next Batch
range and schedule to every 8 min.
